notes: Daily Mixes & Radio Stations: Algorithmic smart stations inspired by Nokia MixRadio that adapt to listening habits, dominant vibes, time of day, and catalog rediscovery.
Resilient Library Sync: Play counts, favorites, and playlists now stay linked when moving files or rescanning storage.
Multi-Copy Support: Duplicate files across different folders (e.g., Music vs. Downloads) maintain independent play counts and ratings.
Track Conflict Resolver: Easily re-link or reconcile moved audio files during backup restoration.
Redesigned Equalizer & FX: Fresh interface featuring rotary dials, bass boost, reverb, and a global bypass toggle.
Spatial Audio Controls: Added stereo widening and channel balance sliders for headphone listening.
Smoother Visualizers: Optimized rendering engine for responsive, low-latency audio visualizers.
Hardware Volume Sync: Player volume now stays directly synchronized with device media steps.
Stable Queue Reordering: Resolved crashes when dragging and dropping tracks in playlists containing duplicates.
Contextual Playlist Naming: Auto-suggests playlist names based on the current playing track or album.
In-App Diagnostics: Added a system log viewer and diagnostic export tool under Settings.
Custom Typography: Added Inter, Lexend, Open Sans, Selawik, and Work Sans font options in Appearance settings.
Hardened Backups: Improved reliability of local JSON export/import for playlists, tags, and history.
Smarter Sleep Timer: stop playback by duration, song count, end of queue, or after a specific track finishes
Custom sleep timer options with direct numeric inputs for precise minutes or track counts
Fixed sleep timer lifecycle: audio now pauses cleanly without breaking UI playback controls or closing the app
New single-tap Track Rating dialog to quickly mark songs as Liked, Disliked, or Neutral
Smoother, jitter-free queue reordering with rock-solid duplicate track handling
Faster and more responsive song lists with scoped recomposition across all library screens
Added home screen app launcher shortcuts to quickly Play, Shuffle, Search, or open Favorites
Fixed background playback stability, lifecycle bugs, and database sync edge cases
Faster, instant loading and smoother sorting in Favorites and smart playlists
Added audio pitch controls in playback settings and player dialogs
Customizable play-count thresholds (set duration percentage or time cap for played tracks)
Fixed playback queue bugs, track skipping, and timeline desync issues
More reliable album artwork loading across the app
Improved playlist backup and restore reliability
Cleaner, refreshed controls and button layout on the Now Playing screen
Simplified onboarding: only audio storage access is required to get started
Easier permission recovery with one-tap shortcuts to App Settings when needed
Added a unified sort-order dialog across all music lists
Migrated core persistence to ObjectBox for sub-millisecond library queries, reactive flows, and atomic metadata updates
Enhanced Artist Hub with MusicBrainz demographics (origin, active years, and lifespan/dissolution tracking) and persistent web relations
Revamped artist visual pipeline with automated Deezer high-res portraits, Wikimedia fallback, and manual MBID/custom artwork overrides
Added Interactive Library Statistics dashboard with play habit leaderboards, storage footprints, and direct navigation to top artist discographies
Added Genres exploration with Spotify-style visual cards and unified multi-genre classification
Expanded Top Bar Quick Discovery hub with direct access to Favorites, Most Played, Recently Played, Recently Added, Genres, and Mood/Context vibes
Re-engineered album artwork pipeline using efficient BitmapFactory downsampling (RGB_565) and embedded ID3 extraction fallback to eliminate scroll stutter
Added MediaStore audio folder exclusion picker and Scoped Storage directory blacklisting in Scan Settings
Integrated 'Set as Ringtone' action with Scoped Storage write fallbacks and system setting permission handling
Upgraded audio playback engine with gapless playback, silence skipping, and volume normalization
Integrated multi-artist and multi-genre splitting across indexing layers, search filters, and detail dialogs
Enhanced Song Info dialog with basicMarquee scrolling, raw storage path inspection, and quick tag editing
TagLib and metadata editor enhancements
Fixed playback service bugs and stability issues
Refined themes, layouts, UI, and documentation tutorials
Added more audio visualizers
Fixed settings screens and reactive state updates
Fixed persistent playlist desync and random reshuffle bug across app restarts
Improved queue state restoration: original pre-shuffled list is now losslessly preserved
UI and mini player stabilization with robust media session synchronization
High-fidelity local audio playback with gapless controls and queue management
Dynamic real-time audio visualizers (Topographic Waves, Concentric Rings, Winamp Classic, and more)
Full-featured Lyric Sync Studio to time, edit, and embed synchronized lyrics directly into track files
Advanced metadata editor with tag management and custom album artwork picker
Dual listening categorization: explore tracks by mood vibes (~) and listening contexts (#)
Modern Jetpack Compose design with dynamic Material You themes and responsive landscape support
